difficulty_reason: Applies lemma-approximate with N = 2 to get A, x_A with x_A isomorphic to x modulo m^2; the formal object eta of x_A over A^ receives a morphism from the versal xi by successive lifting (versal object remark), and the ring map R -> A^ is surjective by the cotangent criterion; the graded pieces have equal dimensions by construction, so the quotients have equal finite length and R -> A^ is an isomorphism; eta is therefore versal and lemma-versality-matches makes x_A versal at the closed point.
